Allah swears by the dawn.
And by ten nights.
And by the even and the odd.
And by the night when it passes.
Is there in all of this a strong enough oath for someone who has sense?
Have you not seen what your Lord did to the people of Ad?
The people of Iram, with their tall pillars and buildings.
The like of which was never made in other lands.
And Thamud, who cut rocks in the valley to make homes.
And Pharaoh, who had mighty armies.
All of them went past the limits in their lands.
And spread a lot of corruption there.
So your Lord poured a whip of punishment on them.
Your Lord is always watching.
When a person is tested with honor and blessings, he says: My Lord has honored me.
But when He tests him by giving him less, he says: My Lord has insulted me.
No! The truth is that you do not honor the orphan.
And you do not encourage each other to feed the poor.
And you eat up the inheritance greedily.
And you love wealth too much.
No! When the earth is crushed into pieces.
And your Lord comes, and the angels come in rows.
And Hell is brought near on that Day. On that Day a person will remember, but how will remembering help him then?
He will say: I wish I had sent something good ahead for my life.
On that Day no one will punish like His punishment.
And no one will tie up like His tying up.
O soul at peace.
Return to your Lord, pleased with Him and pleasing to Him.
Enter among My servants.
And enter My Paradise.
